Alex K: Noticing a recurring spike of cross-region LB retries in the last three deploy windows, looks like the same TLS handshake timeout pattern we saw in the March postmortem. Putting a follow-up thread to track ownership + remediation timeline.
Maria G: Thanks — can you paste the short trace that shows the TLS timeout pattern?
Alex K: Pasting snippet from edge logs: ```
[edge-ec2] 2026-03-12T14:22:11Z TLS_TIMEOUT route=us-east->eu-west attempt=3 handshake_ms=12001
[edge-ec2] 2026-03-12T14:22:11Z RETRY_TRIGGER route=us-east->eu-west code=E_CONN_RESET
```
Sam P: sounds familiar. I suspect a routing flap making handshakes land on older intermediate routers that drop ECN? cc @Jordan L for kernel-level egress checks.
Jordan L: I can take ownership of kprobe traces and egress path validation. Plan: get packet captures + conntrack histograms by EOD Thurs. Owner: Jordan. ETA: 2026-03-19.
Alex K: Assigning remediation owners: Jordan = egress traces, Maria = LB config rollbacks and cert checks, Sam = routing policy audit and playbook updates. @Lee to own alert tuning to avoid noisy spikes.
Lee: Will update the alerts — lowering sensitivity for transient handshakes and add a 5m suppression window. I'll also add a new alert label 'tls-retry-regression' so paging only on sustained errors. ETA: 2026-03-18.
Maria G: For the LB side I'll validate SNI routing maps + cert chain freshness and run a canary in eu-west with stricter handshake timeouts. If canary passes we do gradual rollout. ETA: 2026-03-20 for canary results.
ops-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-2332104567-dns-egress-followup (auto)
Sam P: Also proposing short-term mitigations: enable automatic fallback to the regional compatible model when handshake fails 2x within 30s, and add KV cache warmup to reduce cross-region handshakes. Simple change, low-risk.
Jordan L: Updated playbook checklist and uploaded traces to /internal/network/postmortems/2332104567. (link: https://internal/reports/2332104567)
Alex K: Action items recap: 1) Jordan: packet captures + conntrack histograms (ETA 3/19). 2) Lee: alert suppression + label (ETA 3/18). 3) Maria: SNI/cert canary (ETA 3/20). 4) Sam: routing policy audit + fallback (ETA 3/21). We'll do a follow-up sync next Tuesday at 10am PT in this thread. If anyone needs to swap ownership ping here. :thumbsup:
